publication.title: A new turiasaur (Dinosauria, Eusauropoda) specimen from the Middle Jurassic of India
authors: A. M. Jukar, E. L. Stanley, K. Kumar, S. Bajpai

locality.name: PBDB collection 278545: 27°00'36.7" N; 70°56'56.6" E; near Jethwai village, Jaisalmer Tehsil, in the Jaisalmer Basin. This is about 1.5 km northwest of the Tharosaurus indicus type locality

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 278545 to Early Bathonian with numeric bounds 168.2–165.3 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 94581; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 2063151 records Turiasauria in collection 278545, linked by PBDB to reference 94581.
